nodes.rationale: Durable-before-send storage and acknowledgement handling preserve submissions across process death and disconnects.

nodes.label: Electron process boundary
nodes.rationale: The narrow preload and context isolation boundary keeps filesystem and Electron access in the main process.

nodes.label: Atomic per-file writes
nodes.rationale: Temporary-file replacement protects individual JSON files, while multi-file category operations are explicitly not transactionally atomic.

nodes.label: BNPL date semantics
nodes.rationale: The booking date and behavior date must remain aligned across formulas and persistence normalization so month filters agree between clients.
